build_rate_limit_descriptors: build rate limit descriptors for api key, user, team, model, agent and session from request data and auth context
check_rate_limits: check if rate limits are exceeded for a list of descriptors using sliding window counters in redis or in-memory cache
increment_usage_tokens: increment token counters for api key, user, team, end user, model and agent after a successful llm call
create_agent_rate_limit_descriptors: create agent-level and session-level rate limit descriptors from agent registry and request metadata
handle_rate_limit_error: handle rate limit exceeded by raising an http 429 exception with rate limit headers and reset time
